sentences.text:
THESE M.F.A. AND MFA CROB, COMING ON FOR ADMISSION, THIS DAY, THE COURT DELIVERED THE FOLLOWING:
 JUDGMENT MFA.No.1570/2015 is filed by the Insurance Company by contending that the appellant-Insurance Company has not at all issued the insurance policy.
However, the Tribunal held that the Insurance Company is liable to pay compensation.
Therefore, the present appeal is filed by the Insurance Company.
MFA.Crob.10/2015 is filed by the claimants for seeking enhancement of compensation.

2. The brief facts of the case are that:
It is the case of the claimant that on 10.10.2009 at about 9.30 pm., deceased Eeranna was crossing the road so as to reach Attur Layout to visit the house of Shivanna.
At that time, the motor cycle bearing No.KA-43-H-2827 came with high speed in a rash and negligent manner from South to North direction and dashed against the deceased.
Due to which, the deceased sustained injuries all over the body and later succumbed to the injuries.

Therefore, the claim petition is filed by the claimants and in the said claim petition, the Insurance Company arrayed as respondent No.1 and filed the written statement stating that the Insurance Company has not issued the insurance policy.
The Tribunal has awarded compensation by fastening liability on the Insurance Company to pay compensation to the claimants.

3. Heard argument from both sides and perused the records.
4.

Sri A.N.Krishna Swamy, learned Senior counsel submitted that the appellant-Insurance Company has not at all issued any insurance policy and cover note, but respondent No.2 has played fraud by stating that there is NC: 2024:KHC:21545 insurance policy and based on the police document, the Tribunal has erroneously fastened liability on the Insurance Company without verifying the facts as to whether insurance policy was existed or not.

Further submitted that when the appellant-Insurance Company in their written statement before the Tribunal has specifically denied the insurance policy, but in the judgment, the Tribunal has wrongly observed at paragraph No.15 that the Insurance Company has not specifically denied the issuance of insurance policy, which is Smt Rathnamma vs Branch Manager on 14 June, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/64813738/
4 perverse in nature.

sentences.text: Therefore, submitted that the owner of the motor cycle might have played fraud in collusion with the police.
Hence, the issuance of policy is not in existence and hence, prays to allow the appeal by setting aside the liability fastened on the Insurance Company.
5. Alternatively, he prays to remand the matters to the Tribunal to decide the disputed fact regarding whether the insurance policy was existed or not.
Therefore, prays to allow the appeal and set aside the judgment and award passed by the Tribunal.

6. On the other hand, learned counsel for the claimants/cross objectors submitted that the Tribunal has justified in holding that the Insurance Company has not specifically denied the issuance of insurance policy.
Since, the denial in the written statement is a vague denial, therefore, justified the judgment and award passed by the Tribunal.
Therefore, prays to dismiss the appeal and allow the cross objection by enhancing the quantum of compensation.

7. In the present case, upon perusing the written statement filed by the appellant-Insurance Company, the Insurance Company has specifically taken the contention that issuance of insurance policy is denied.

It is the case of the appellant-Insurance Company that the Insurance Company has not at all issued any insurance policy to NC: 2024:KHC:21545 respondent No.6, but respondent No.6 who is the owner of motor cycle was placed exparte before the Tribunal.

8. When the Insurance Company has specifically denied the issuance of insurance policy, then it is the burden either on the claimants or respondent No.6-owner to prove the existence of insurance policy, because negative evidence cannot be proved by the Insurance Company.
Therefore, there is a disputed fact arises in this case as to whether there was existence of insurance policy or not.
This is the facts in issue to be proved before the Tribunal.
But to this, the exercise in the trial before the Tribunal was not made either of the parties.

Therefore, the matters are needed to be remanded to the Tribunal for fresh consideration of the matters to find out as to whether there was insurance policy or not as on the date of time of accident as contended by the claimants.

9. Though, evidence was led in the Miscellaneous Application, but in the said Miscellaneous Application, the NC: 2024:KHC:21545 disputed fact cannot be decided regarding whether the Insurance Company has issued the insurance policy or not.
Therefore, the matters are to be remanded to the Tribunal for fresh consideration directing the Tribunal to receive evidence from both parties and decide the case in accordance with law.
10. All contentions are left upon.
The parties are given liberty to adduce any further evidence, if they so desire.
Therefore, the judgment and award passed by the Tribunal is hereby set aside by allowing the appeals.
Consequently, the matters are remanded to the Tribunal for fresh consideration.

Accordingly, I proceed to pass the following ORDER I. MFA.No.1570/2015 filed by the Insurance company is allowed.
II. MFA.Crob.No.108/2015 filed by the claimants is disposed of.
